name: Leads Team
description: A human leads a team. The source is a human; the target is a team. Cardinality is not constrained: a human may belong to or lead several teams, a team may have several parents or leaders, and the edge records the situation instead of refusing it. A cycle (team A inside team B inside team A) is not refused either; finding one is a read, not a write rule. Leading does not imply belonging: a leader with no BELONGS_TO_TEAM edge to the team is allowed, and a report may flag one.
